title: Gym Intel UAE — Membership offers

options.content:
**Recorded offers, not live quotes or equivalent memberships.** Dates and terms differ; **Unknown is not zero**. Click a bar or gym name for its official source and check date. Fees are separate; VAT status covers the membership price only.

**Warehouse:** historical access scope remains unresolved.

panels.title: Advertised monthly gym charges — terms and dates differ
panels.description: Latest recorded single-branch monthly offer for each gym/branch/plan, alphabetical, not a cheapest or best-gym ranking. Click a bar for its observation date, commitment, joining/admin fees, VAT, renewal and official source. Unknown is not zero. Only the monthly membership charge is plotted; no total-cost or equivalent-benefits claim. Observation dates are retained in source details rather than appended to gym names; recorded prices are not live quotes. Warehouse's historical access scope remains unresolved. A newer unknown, annual or conflicting observation does not fall back to an older price. The compact table below shows the same selected offers and their conditions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH dated AS (
  SELECT m.*,
    MAX(observed_on) OVER (
      PARTITION BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name
    ) AS latest_offer_date
  FROM dashboard_memberships AS m
), latest AS (
  SELECT brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on,
    MIN(access_scope) AS access_scope,
    MIN(billing_period_months) AS billing_period_months,
    MIN(advertised_price_aed) AS advertised_price_aed,
    MIN(minimum_commitment_months) AS minimum_commitment_months,
    MIN(joining_fee_aed) AS joining_fee_aed,
    MIN(admin_fee_aed) AS admin_fee_aed,
    MIN(payment_structure) AS payment_structure,
    MIN(renewal_policy) AS renewal_policy,
    MIN(price_vat_status) AS price_vat_status,
    MIN(source_url) AS source_url,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT source_url, ' | ') AS all_sources
  FROM dated
  WHERE observed_on = latest_offer_date
  GROUP BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name, observed_on
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ROW(
    access_scope, billing_period_months, advertised_price_aed,
    minimum_commitment_months, joining_fee_aed, admin_fee_aed,
    payment_structure, renewal_policy, price_vat_status
  )) = 1
), labelled AS (
  SELECT *,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand_name) AS offers_for_brand
  FROM latest
  WHERE access_scope = 'single_branch'
    AND billing_period_months = 1
    AND advertised_price_aed IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT brand_name ||
    CASE WHEN offers_for_brand > 1
      THEN ' · ' || branch_name || ' · ' || plan_name ELSE '' END AS "Gym",
  advertised_price_aed::double precision AS "Advertised charge",
  observed_on::text AS "Observed",
  source_url AS "Source",
  'Minimum commitment: ' ||
    CASE WHEN minimum_commitment_months IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
      WHEN minimum_commitment_months = 0 THEN 'No minimum'
      WHEN minimum_commitment_months = 1 THEN '1 month'
      ELSE minimum_commitment_months::text || ' months' END ||
    '; Joining: ' || COALESCE('AED ' || joining_fee_aed::text, 'Unknown') ||
    '; Admin: ' || COALESCE('AED ' || admin_fee_aed::text, 'Unknown') ||
    '; VAT: ' || COALESCE(price_vat_status, 'Unknown') ||
    '; Payment: ' || CASE payment_structure
      WHEN 'recurring' THEN 'Recurring'
      WHEN 'prepaid_term' THEN 'Prepaid term' ELSE 'Unknown' END ||
    '; Renewal: ' || CASE renewal_policy
      WHEN 'automatic' THEN 'Automatic'
      WHEN 'non_automatic' THEN 'Not automatic' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Terms",
  branch_name AS "Branch",
  plan_name AS "Original plan",
  all_sources AS "Supporting sources"
FROM labelled
ORDER BY brand_name, branch_name, plan_name

panels.title: Offer conditions — same offers as the graph
panels.description: Five visible columns for the exact offers selected by the graph, in the same alphabetical order. Joining and admin fees remain separate; Unknown is not zero. Membership VAT does not establish fee tax treatment. Click a gym name for the official source and observation date; source metadata and the original plan remain in Inspect data. These are differing offers, not equivalent memberships or payable totals.
